final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT t.observstation AS os, o.weathprofile AS wp, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avgband, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY t.observstation, o.weathprofile), s2 AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.wp, s1.avgband, s1.cnt, CAST(s1.cnt AS REAL) / s2.total AS ratio FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.total IS NOT NULL), s4 AS (SELECT wp, AVG(avgband) AS a, AVG(cnt) AS c, AVG(ratio) AS r FROM s3 GROUP BY wp) SELECT AVG(a), AVG(c), AVG(r) FROM s4
